I. End of the first Green Revolution period
II. Intensive Agriculture District Programme (IADP)
III. Establishment of the M.S. Swaminathan Research Foundation

new.x: IADP came first (1960-61), then the first Green Revolution period ended, and the M.S. Swaminathan Research Foundation was set up in 1988. So the order is II, I, III. Every other option either puts the end of the first Green Revolution period before IADP or puts MSSRF (1988) before it.
new.tq: IADP 1960-61 -> first GR ends -> MSSRF 1988 = II, I, III.
